headline: Strategic Fronts Stir Across Several Sectors
war_summary: Since the previous edition, Fisherman’s Row has become the liveliest strategic ledger, recording eight base events in the latest two hours and 26 across the day; its board now stands six Colonial to three Warden bases. Linn Mercy remains under sustained pressure, with three recent events and 32 in 24 hours, though all 11 positions presently remain Warden-held. Lykos Isle has also registered two fresh events, with five Warden and two Colonial bases and sharply accelerating casualties on both sides. Stlican Shelf reports two events in the latest two hours amid a marked surge in fighting, while its nine-base board remains eight Warden to one Colonial. Godcrofts has seen three recent events at Lipsia, despite retaining all nine bases under Warden control. The heaviest casualty ledgers belong to Weathered Expanse and Clahstra, where losses and enlistments are accelerating, though neither has logged a base event in the latest two-hour window. Deadlands remains contested and bloody but has likewise gone quiet on ownership movement most recently; Kings Cage and Tempest Island have also recorded no fresh two-hour events.
